varmodel_score — SPC variation op

• Data kinds: image2d × table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.varmodel_score(image, model, mask=None, align='check') (to call the implementation directly, import varmodel; varmodel.varmodel_score(image, model, mask=None, align='check'); from the registry, opsspc.get("varmodel_score"))

Usage

Score one image against a varmodel_fit model: z map in sigmas, out-of-band map and a per-region explanation (table).

z = (image - center) / spread on valid pixels (0 elsewhere); a pixel is out of band when |z| > k. Out-of-band pixels are grouped into 8-connected regions; each region reports area, peak_z (signed, the largest |z|), mean_abs_z, polarity (bright / dark / mixed), centroid (row, col), bbox (r0, c0, r1, c1, exclusive end) and peak_pos; regions are sorted by |peak_z| (rounded to 1e-9, ties by label order). Also returns z, exceed, valid (scored pixels, image grid), n_exceed, n_valid, k, far, expected_false = far * n_valid and count_pvalue = P(Binomial(n_valid, far) >= n_exceed) — that p-value assumes independent pixels and is optimistic for spatially correlated noise (reported, not used to decide).

Alignment: the image's translation against the model centre is measured as in varmodel_alignment and returned as offset. align="check" REFUSES an image displaced by more than the model's max_misalign_px; align="translate" registers it to the model by a Fourier shift, computes z in model coordinates and maps z / exceed back onto the image grid by the rounded offset (the wrapped border is invalid), so the maps line up with masks drawn on the original image. mask is on the image grid.

Raises ValueError when image is empty / not 2-D / non-finite, its shape differs from the model, model lacks the fitted keys, mask has the wrong shape, align is unknown, or the image is misaligned (check) / displaced by more than a quarter of the image (translate).
